purpose: Move the working tree to 0.0.35 because 0.0.34 is published with artefacts that do not contain the S27-S32 code. Rebuild the Phase-2 install from the credited source, re-run the ABI courts, rebind the downstream atlas identity while keeping carried-forward rows explicitly unverified at the new identity, and regenerate the documentation so the published and unpublished states cannot be confused.

version_bump.note: Only the openssl-rs package version changed. Cargo.lock dependency entries are untouched.

working_tree_release.note: The tree is explicitly unreleased. No published artefact contains the S27-S32 code.

rebuild.target_dir_note: build_phase2.sh hardwires CRATE=/work/target/release, so the build used the existing on-disk /work/target (bind-mounted NVMe, never tmpfs). TMPDIR stayed on /work/court/tmp; the container overlay was not used for build output.

determinism.note: Two consecutive builds of the same source produced byte-identical artefacts, so the identity delta below is a source/metadata delta, not build nondeterminism.

identity_delta_cause.source_change: none beyond Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock version bump; git diff for src/ is empty
identity_delta_cause.mechanism: the crate version participates in rustc crate metadata, so every linked object changes its crate-metadata identity even though the compiled Rust code is unchanged
evidence: the build is deterministic across runs
no literal version string is embedded in the artefacts
the version bump is the only source change in the tree

evidence_reuse.note: The 157 L7 rows were measured with evidence_reuse=null at the S31 identity. They are not re-measured at the 0.0.35 identity; every measured family is carried forward, including all 33 Safe-33 cohort families.

atlas_rebind.build_link_atlas_note: forensics/downstream/build-link-atlas.json is left untouched. It is the historical record of the S31 build/link measurement at 2b0ff1b6/f99f7159 and is not the artifact the documentation generator reads for candidate identity. Rebinding it without re-running its 3,506-second measurement would claim a measurement that was not made.
